content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-71234 fired for service=redwood-serving-us-west-az3 — 5xx_rate=12.8% over 5m. Paging primary oncall: tilly.

tilly (oncall): ack — i'm up. looking.

pagerduty-bot: Tilly acknowledged the alert at 2024-11-02T15:42:20Z

maya (sre): grabbing graphs — KV cache evictions spiking, p95 latency up, queue depth increased.

sam (infra): seeing 502s from shard-az3-proxy, control-plane errors concurrent.

nate (platform): are we auto-failing over? what's the runbook say? runbook: https://runbooks/internal/az-fallback

til ly (oncall): step 1: divert new traffic to us-west-az2 via routing policy. I'm executing now.

til ly (oncall): /runbook execute fallback-route us-west-az2

ops-bot: routing change applied, traffic diverted approx 40% -> us-west-az2 :rotating_light:

maya (sre): KV-cache eviction logs:
```
[2024-11-02T15:40:11Z] shard=az3 cache_evictions=1200 score=0.87
[2024-11-02T15:41:11Z] shard=az3 cache_evictions=1800 score=0.93
```

sam (infra): starting a soft rolling restart of proxy fleet in az3 (5 at a time)

emily (cs): any customer impact? CS dashboard shows bump in 502s for orgs on az3: 14 customers with degraded responses, few reaching SLO-S1. prepping message.

nate (platform): enabling autoscale burst for az3 pool + increase token processing concurrency now.

til ly (oncall): autoscale request sent to controller:
```
POST /api/scale {"zone":"az3","delta_instances":10}
```

ops-bot: controller accepted request, scaling started

maya (sre): p95 dropping after 20% diversion + scale. 5xx rate down to 3.2% in last 2m. continuing monitor.

til ly (oncall): handing off to maya for post-fix watch and RCA. @maya you take primary? i'll update pagerduty assignment.

pagerduty-bot: Tilly reassigned incident to Maya SRE.

maya (sre): acked. i'll watch 30m then begin RCA notes. sam — capture proxy restart logs & kvcache stats please.

sam (infra): logs collected: s3://redwood-ops/logs/7265432100/az3-proxy-restart.tar.gz

emily (cs): drafting interim customer note for status page and notifying CS leads. will tag affected orgs list to incident ticket.

til ly (oncall): closing PD alert — will reopen if 5xx > 5% again in 10m.

incident-bot: Alert PD-71234 resolved by tilly at 2024-11-02T15:46:36Z (duration 4m16s)

maya (sre): quick action items: (1) investigate root cause of kvcache eviction spike (OOM or mem leak?) (2) add circuit-breaker for proxy 502 surge (3) tune autoscale thresholds. i'll create tasks and link here.

emily (cs): note for comms: affected customers attached to incident ticket; CS will follow up with impacted customers.

til ly (oncall): thanks team — fast coordination. :thumbsup:
